name: RLAD-abstractions-benchmarks-classifications
description: A collection of classification tasks related to abstractions used in reinforcement learning and decision-making research. The benchmark measures how well models can classify or label high-level abstractions/representations derived from RL environments or policies. It is intended to evaluate representational and generalization properties of models used in RL research.
reputation: Relatively niche dataset used in research on RL abstractions and representation learning with limited broad adoption.
